rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, it must have a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and its gun must point at that target within 3.0°, so it never fires without such a target.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward, the free distance ahead minus the distance driven must remain at least 80 pixels, and whenever it drives backward, the free distance behind minus the distance driven backward must remain at least 80 pixels; if it doesn't drive, this imposes nothing.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

explanation.headline: Proved: all 3 rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved all three rules (S1 affordable shots, S2 fire only at a target seen this turn and aimed at, S3 keep 80 px from walls and buildings when driving). Neither the open-arena nor the urban battle recorded any violations, which fits the proofs.
